verdict.rationale: Databricks documents versioned REST APIs (e.g. Jobs v2.0) and explicit deprecation/migration notices such as the legacy SQL API deprecation and CLI 0.18→0.205 migration guide, showing a working pattern of API versioning plus deprecation notices. However, evidence does not show a single, formal cross-product deprecation policy (support windows, sunset timelines) — only scattered per-API migration pages. missing for 10: a consolidated deprecation policy page with timelines/support windows, independent/third-party confirmation that the policy is consistently honored.
